title: Other people's selections
blurb: An article in a canvas with other readers' selections drawn into it: a colour, a bar at the moving end and a name flag for each. Selections travel as text offsets over a BroadcastChannel between the page, a frame and other tabs.
question: Can a canvas show the selections of several other readers in its text without changing the DOM or the reader's own selection?
result: Yes. Any Range has rectangles, selected or not.
